title: Configuration Has Left the Container
missionBriefing: env-reader cannot start because its external configuration contract is broken. Repair it so the container runs with the required ConfigMap mode and Secret-backed token.
successCriteria: TOKEN equals mission-token and remains Secret-backed.
hints: Compare each env key reference with the ConfigMap and Secret keys.
The Pod expects app_mode in app-settings; create that exact key with value practice.
